metadata.title: A formalized Lean 4 statement of the q-analog Erdős–Ko–Rado theorem, with a documented Mathlib substrate gap
metadata.description:
This deposit is a formalized STATEMENT of the q-analog Erdős–Ko–Rado theorem together with an explicitly documented capability gap. It is NOT a formalized proof.

The artifact, built in Lean 4 against Mathlib4 v4.29.0 (toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.29.0, Mathlib SHA 8a178386ffc0, SHA-pinned), comprises: (i) QEkr.IsDimIntersectingOf, a q-analog of Mathlib's intersecting-families predicate that measures pairwise intersection by Module.finrank instead of Finset.card (fully proved API); and (ii) QEkr.q_ekr, a type-checked statement of the q-EKR (t = 1) bound: every 1-intersecting family of k-dimensional subspaces of 𝔽_q^n has cardinality at most that of a point-pencil through a fixed line.

The proof of q_ekr is not formalized. Its body is a deliberate sorry marking an AEAL capability gap: the Mathlib v4.29.0 substrate required to discharge it is absent — specifically (a) q-binomial / Gaussian-binomial coefficients over 𝔽_q (zero declarations in Mathlib v4.29.0), (b) 𝔽_q subspace / Grassmannian counting (point-pencil enumeration and equinumerosity), and (c) the q-analog EKR extremal argument (Mathlib's only EKR is the classical finset version, which does not transfer to subspaces). lake build succeeds modulo exactly one intended sorry warning, and #print axioms QEkr.q_ekr lists sorryAx alongside propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound — the honest statement-not-proof signal, retained deliberately (not suppressed, not swapped for an axiom).

The companion document capability/qekr_substrate.gap.md gives the full gap analysis, a dependency-ordered roadmap for a future formalizer, and the method-substitution history (Frankl–Wilson eigenvalue → compression → direct point-pencil counting, each substituted on a substrate failure). This is an honest partial result suitable as a short note / Mathlib-statement contribution — NOT the closed-proof Mathlib4 PR originally targeted.
metadata.notes: Status: Tier-2 — a formalized STATEMENT plus a documented capability gap; NOT a proof. The q_ekr proof body is a deliberate sorry; the build warning and sorryAx in the axiom cone are intentional and must not be suppressed. Repository licensing: source code under the repository LICENSE (currently MIT), documentation and prose (capability/qekr_substrate.gap.md, README) under LICENSE-DOCS (CC-BY-4.0); this Zenodo record is deposited under CC-BY-4.0 to match the program's statement-shape deposits (K_0, EBR). NOTE for the operator: the Lean file headers declare 'Released under Apache 2.0 license' while the repository LICENSE file is MIT — a pre-existing inconsistency that should be reconciled before any Mathlib4 PR (Mathlib requires Apache-2.0 headers and an Apache-2.0 LICENSE). AI-use disclosure: GitHub Copilot CLI (powered by Anthropic Claude) and Anthropic Claude were used to assist with code generation, build/axiom-cone verification, and documentation drafting under an explicit-evidence-acceptance-and-logging (AEAL) discipline. After using these tools, the author reviewed and edited the content and takes full responsibility for it. The AI tools are not authors. Part of the AEAL-disciplined 'unsolved-relay' series; the statement-shape sibling is mission K_0 (khinchin-k0-bounded), Zenodo concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20246707.

_operator_decisions.field: Lean-header license vs LICENSE file (pre-existing repo inconsistency)
_operator_decisions.finding: Lean file headers (QEkr/*.lean) declare 'Copyright (c) 2026 papanokechi. All rights reserved. Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.' — but the repository LICENSE file is 'MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Papanokechi'. Headers reference Apache-2.0; the file is MIT. LICENSE-DOCS is CC-BY-4.0.
_operator_decisions.impact: Internal inconsistency. Matters especially for a future Mathlib4 PR, which REQUIRES Apache-2.0 file headers AND an Apache-2.0 LICENSE. The CC-BY-4.0 Zenodo deposit license is independent of this and is fine.
_operator_decisions.recommendation: FLAGGED for operator to reconcile header-vs-LICENSE consistency before any Mathlib PR. DO NOT edit headers as part of this PREPARE task (operator decision).

_operator_decisions.finding: K_0 links isPartOf the SIARC PCF umbrella 10.5281/zenodo.19885549 ('An Arithmetic Stratification of Polynomial Continued Fractions'). q-EKR is extremal set theory / finite-geometry combinatorics, NOT a polynomial-continued-fraction result, so an isPartOf to the SIARC-PCF umbrella would be a category mismatch and was intentionally NOT added.
_operator_decisions.recommendation: If an 'unsolved-relay' series umbrella DOI exists (distinct from SIARC-PCF), the operator may add it as isPartOf. Otherwise leave only the GitHub repo (isSupplementTo) and the K_0 concept DOI (references).

_operator_decisions.finding: https://github.com/papanokechi/unsolved-relay-2-erdos-ko-rado-q-analog-lean currently returns HTTP 404 because the repo is PRIVATE (gh: isPrivate=true). The K_0 concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20246707 resolves (concept → record 20246708, verified via Zenodo API).
